units.source_text: 时至今日，我已经有两三次想要在命运的指引下，走向极乐世界。

en.t: Even now, there have already been two or three times when, led on by fate, I wanted to go toward the world of bliss.

units.source_text: 但是，每次都割舍不下妻子。

en.t: But each time, I could not tear myself away from my wife.

units.source_text: 当然，我没有把妻子一同带走的勇气，连向妻子坦白真相我都做不到，

en.t: Of course, I did not have the courage to take my wife with me, and I could not even confess the truth to her,

units.source_text: 更何况夺走妻子的天年，让她为我的命运殉葬这样残忍的事情，想想都心惊肉跳。

en.t: so the cruel thought of cutting short her natural life and making her die as a sacrifice to my fate made me shudder even to imagine it.

units.source_text: 正如我有我的宿命一样，妻也有妻的命运，

en.t: Just as I had my own destiny, my wife had hers,

units.source_text: 把两个人绑在一起去火化，于情于理都只能使我觉得残忍之极。

en.t: and to bind the two of us together and send us to the flames could only seem to me, in every sense, the height of cruelty.

units.source_text: 同时，一想到我死之后妻子的境况，实在可怜。

en.t: At the same time, when I thought of my wife's situation after my death, she seemed truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 岳母死时，妻曾对我诉说过，从今往后，这世上她可依赖的只有我一个人了。

en.t: When my mother-in-law died, my wife once told me that from then on I was the only person in the world she could rely on.

units.source_text: 这句话让我刻骨铭心。

en.t: Those words were carved deeply into my heart.

units.source_text: 这让我一直犹豫不决，

en.t: Because of that, I remained unable to make up my mind,

units.source_text: 有时望着妻子的脸，也想过幸好没有走绝路，

en.t: and at times, looking at my wife's face, I even thought it was fortunate I had not taken the final path,

units.source_text: 于是又放弃了这个打算。

en.t: and so I would give up the idea again.

units.source_text: 因此妻子常常以不满的眼光望着我。

en.t: Because of this, my wife often looked at me with dissatisfied eyes.

units.source_text: 我就是这样生活过来的，

en.t: This is how I had lived my life,

units.source_text: 在镰仓同你初次相遇时，和你一起在郊外散步时，

en.t: when I first met you in Kamakura, and when I walked with you in the outskirts,

units.source_text: 我的心情都没有多大变化，

en.t: there was no great change in my state of mind,

units.source_text: 我的身后总跟着一条黑影。

en.t: and a dark shadow was always following behind me.

units.source_text: 我仿佛是为了妻子才苟延残喘地活在世上似的，

en.t: It was as if I was only dragging out my life in this world for my wife's sake,

units.source_text: 你毕业后回家乡的时候，也是如此。

en.t: and it was the same when you returned to your hometown after graduation.

units.source_text: 我跟你约定在九月相见，并没有说谎，

en.t: When I promised to see you in September, I was not lying,

units.source_text: 那时真的想再见到你。

en.t: for at that time I truly wanted to see you again.

units.source_text: 我想秋天过去，还有冬天，

en.t: I thought that after autumn passed, winter would still come,

units.source_text: 就是冬天过去了，我也是想见到你的。

en.t: and even after winter had passed, I still intended to see you.
